text:
sophie: Hey team — first day. I can sign into Okta but every time I try to set up MFA it says the verification code was sent to sophie.temp@gmail.com, which is my personal email. I never got a 1Password invite to sophie@redwood.ai and Drive shows 'request access'. Who should I ping for a quick fix?

it-aaron: Welcome @sophie! Sorry about that. It looks like our provisioning service created two Okta profiles (one with your temp recruiter email). Can you confirm your official work email?

sophie: it's sophie@redwood.ai. Recruiter had used sophie.temp@gmail.com initially.

matt-onboard: @it-aaron I can see duplicate user entry in Okta - one is staged. Recommend we merge and remove the temp alias, resend 1Password, and enable a temporary TOTP for onboarding.

welcome-bot: Ticket created: ONB-5623 — "Sophie: duplicate Okta/alt email causing MFA and 1P invite". Assigned to it-aaron. ETA 90 minutes.

it-aaron: OK I'm removing the temp account and clearing the alt email from your profile. I'll resend 1Password and enable a short-lived TOTP fallback so you can finish MFA immediately.

sophie: Thanks. I got the 1Password invite now and added the TOTP code. MFA passed. Drive still had request access for one doc though.

matt-onboard: I just added you to the doc viewer group and re-triggered group sync. Try Drive again and let us know.

sophie: Drive works now, I can open the onboarding folder. Everything else looks good — device shows 'Enrolled' in Okta and I created a passkey in Safari. Thanks for the fast help :smile:

it-aaron: Great — closing ONB-5623 in a bit. Welcome to the team @sophie!
